page.overview:
Who is Kenzo?

Kenzo is a Private Sector Devil Hunter who has been working as one for the past seven years.

Kenzo is an average man with short brown hair parted in the middle.

He wears a track suit colored green in the anime with sneakers.

Kenzo is especially confident in his skills to take out devils, but he makes sure not to get too cocky. He takes the opportunity to work with other devil hunters should the chance arise, but has little problems working alone.
